## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `uv run pytest` passes in `core/`
- [ ] Verification stays deterministic (same input, byte-identical report); method version bumped if the logic changed
- [ ] Simulated data is still labelled as simulated
- [ ] Documentation updated, including the Finnish translation if the document has one
- [ ] User-visible change? A line is added under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Sources (libraries, standards, data providers) are linked, not written from memory
